name: Chiwassu!

boost.name: Sup!
effect: NOW: Draw a card.
AFTER: If you hit, return this Boost to your hand.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 以Subaru的招牌招呼語『ちわーす！』為概念。極速低傷的開場技，命中後搶回先手權，表現她陽光活力的登場總能帶動全場節奏。Boost設計呼應她反覆打招呼的親切形象。

name: HOT DUCK!

boost.name: LAMBDUCK
effect: +1 Power and +1 Range.
HIT: Push the opponent 1 or 2 spaces. If the opponent is pushed into a corner, +2 Power.
description: 以Subaru的鴨子主題原創曲《HOT DUCK!》為靈感。中距離火焰鴨攻擊，利用推牆效果增加傷害，如同Subaru的鴨子迷因無孔不入、無處不在。

name: Manager's Orders

boost.name: Daily Practice
effect: At the start of each of your turns, you may discard a card to draw a card.
BEFORE: Draw 2 cards.
description: 呼應Subaru的官方設定——綜合格鬥技部與電競部的經理。高護甲抽牌技，表現她作為經理管理團隊、調度資源的能力，同時也反映她『努力家』的認真練習態度。

name: Suba-tomo, Let's Go!

boost.name: Subaru's Army
effect: NOW: Put a card from your hand face-down as a boost in play (limit 1). It counts as a Continuous Boost with +1 Power.
HIT: Gain 2 life. You may add the top card of your discard to your Gauge.
description: 以Subaru號召粉絲的口號『Suba-tomo, let's go!』和粉絲名『Subaru's Army』為概念。團隊鼓舞型攻擊，命中後回復生命並回收資源，象徵粉絲的支持讓Subaru永不放棄。

name: Kono Migi no Hito!

boost.name: Subaru Police
effect: Ignore Guard.
HIT: Opponent must reveal their hand.
BEFORE: Name a card. If the opponent has that card in their hand, +2 Power and Ignore Guard.
description: 以Subaru的『この右の人！』警察迷因為設計概念。指認犯人的精準攻擊，猜中對手手牌時威力大增，表現出Subaru像警察一樣敏銳指認目標的搞笑形象。

name: Mesubaru Spark

boost.name: Tomboy Switch
effect: This card gains +3 Speed if you are below half life.
Ignore Armor.
HIT: Pull the opponent 1 space. Gain Advantage.
description: 以Subaru的反差萌『メスバル』模式為靈感。平時像男生的她偶爾展現的可愛一面。近距離強力反擊，無視護甲、拉近對手，表現她隱藏的少女爆發力。

name: Solar Manager

boost.name: Hololive no Taiyou
effect: +2 Armor and +2 Guard.
NOW: Gain 1 life.
HIT: Close 1 space. If you close any spaces, gain 2 life.
description: 以Subaru的稱號『ホロライブの太陽』為概念。光芒照耀隊友的防禦型技能，高Guard值配合生命恢復，體現她如同太陽般溫暖、照亮周圍的人的角色特質。

name: Shuba Shuba Shuba!

boost.name: Duck Rapid Fire
effect: HIT: You may play another Special card from your hand with cost 0 (do not discard it).
HIT: Draw a card. You may immediately play a Boost from your hand without paying its cost.
description: 以Subaru興奮時的招牌口癖『しゅばしゅばしゅば』為靈感。高速連擊奧義，命中後可追加額外行動，如同Subaru興奮時連珠炮般的發言節奏，一發接一發不停歇。

name: YAGOO!!!

boost.name: CEO Renaming
effect: BEFORE: Name a card type (Special, Ultra, or Boost). Your opponent must discard a card of that type from their hand, or reveal a hand with none.
Stun Immunity.
HIT: Your opponent discards 2 random cards. Add this card to your hand instead of your discard.
description: 以Subaru將Cover CEO谷郷元昭誤唸成『YAGOO』的歷史性事件為概念。命中後擾亂對手手牌並回收自身，如同這個誤稱永久改變了Hololive歷史，深遠影響力永不消退。

name: Heart Scar Ignition

boost.name: Survive and Shine
effect: Spend all remaining life. For each life spent this way, +1 Power for this Strike.
Cannot be guarded.
CRITICAL: Opponent cannot use Boosts this Strike.
HIT: Gain 5 life.
description: 以Subaru心臟手術後胸口留下的愛心疤痕為概念——她將生命的脆弱轉化為前進的力量。極慢但毀滅性的最終奧義，不可防禦，燃燒殘餘生命換取更強傷害，命中後大幅恢復，展現她從逆境中重生、永不放棄的意志力。
